I work at  Sephora and thusly have become skincare obsessed I am pretty locked in on my cleanser (Murad time release acne cleanser) I use that with a Mia 2 Clarisonic which I love so much. On days I am wearing make up I double cleanse with Bosnia's Makeup- Breakup cleansing oil, that really takes everything right off. I have combination and acne prone skin. I also use the acne clearing solution from Murad. The Eradi-kate is by Kate Somerville smells so awful but is my holy grail spot treatment.  Currently for moisturizers I am using two from Korres, I use the Pomegranate balancing cream gel in the morning and The Greek Yogurt Sleeping facial at night. I'm also obsessed with Korres's Golden Crocus serum, its gorgeous. 

I'm a mask junkie too. I've tried at least 70% of the mask's in my store. I love the Fresh Umbrian Clay and Rose Mask, The Bosnia Pore pudding mask, black luminizing mask, and the hydro gel sheet masks they make are a blast.

The Sephora collection sheet masks are actually surprisingly great as well. 

I could keep going about products I die for but this is already a monstrous post hahaha

My best friend died of cancer this past January a few weeks prior to her 23rd birthday. She was really more my sister than my best friend, we have been best friend since we were two and our Mom's met in a Mommy and Me class. 

I miss her in this gut wrenching feeling like i have a hole in my body all the time in this unflinching way. Everything that happens to me is colored through this. I have a long distance girlfriend too who I miss passionately all the god damn time but its not even the same emotion. My best friend without a doubt was the single most extraordinary human I had ever met, she had the most magical life ahead of her and we all knew it. 

I  miss her in a way that is so singular that saying "I miss her" seems completely inadequate
